note: Lexical signatures distilled from solved targets (sanitized). Detection is evidence for routing, not proof; always confirm at runtime.

families.label: jsvmpzl-style commercial JSVMP (v1.5.x observed)
families.capability_hint: verbatim execution + interpreter-catch hook; opcode restoration only if verbatim is blocked

families.label: opaque-predicate bloat (Math-typeof chains)
families.capability_hint: predicates are always-true noise; locate real statements, prefer verbatim

families.label: obfuscator.io-style string array with rotation
families.capability_hint: webcrack FIRST (handles v4 proxy-function variants the in-house string-table recovery does not); recover_string_table.js only for simpler rotations; then AST pipeline

families.label: environment-gated constant tables
families.capability_hint: env-gated-crypto playbook; verbatim sandbox + calibration oracle

families.label: timer-driven self-check shells
families.capability_hint: real timers + uncaughtException no-ops (recipe card 4, pattern M3)

families.label: Huffman-coded token with sliding-window counter packets
families.capability_hint: token is base64(A-segment)|windows(B-segment); extract the tree builder and window encoder verbatim

families.label: RSA-encrypted token bound to path/time/page
families.capability_hint: page-computed signature; inline-proxy delivery, page must compute per request

families.label: webpack/browserify module bundle
families.capability_hint: extract the signer module via module map; deobfuscate-mcp-style module DB helps

families.label: custom bytecode-array JSVMP (decimal opcode array + switch dispatch)
families.capability_hint: verbatim full-page (jsdom) preferred; interpreter carries its own ip in error messages — hook the outer catch for swallowed-exception logging

families.label: random-named per-challenge scripts
families.capability_hint: per-challenge random script name — fetch the live src via CDP DOM (never guess); webcrack-first

families.label: CryptoJS passphrase-mode ciphertext
families.capability_hint: OpenSSL format: b64(Salted__+8B salt+ct); EVP_BytesToKey(md5, passphrase, salt) -> key+iv; pure-python repro (no cryptojs needed)

families.label: JD risk-control h5st family (js-security-v3-rac)
families.capability_hint: served GZIP over .js URL (decode before analysis); string table via charcode XOR 47 with # escape; h5st signer entry; locate-then-verbatim (full solve requires authorized account scope)
